input.subject: Nico Robin
input.continuity: One Piece manga through the end of Wano Country arc
input.intent: Produce a faithful playable Straw Hat unit using the current Manga Mayhem contract. Exactly three paths of five concrete cumulative purchases, legal maximum 5-2-0. Every purchase must change executable behavior. Source facts must be established by fresh research. Disclose numerical tuning, unlock schedules and bounded interpretations as game adaptations; distinguish omitted powers from implemented powers. This is a stationary tower encounter with caller-supplied enemy motion and ally injuries, not tower defensive combat or free unit movement. Avoid unsupported air-only target classes, tower HP, shields, taunt, or invented powers. If a source trait has no runtime representation, preserve it in an explicit omission rather than a fake stat bonus. Use the supported schema exactly, including resources, projectile flight, target geometry, statuses, and shared technique lifecycle. Balance is a later measured pass; prices are provisional. World units are shared across the crew: ordinary close contact roughly 8-18, stretched or ranged profiles roughly 30-60; do not treat these as canon measurements. Keep signatures recognizable and source-backed. Hana Hana limb replication, multi-target Clutch/holds, Gigante Fleur and Demonio Fleur through Wano. Powers blossom on targets; do not make hands traveling bullets. Holds limited by enemy eligibility and boss immunity. Demonio is a technique or form of limb construction, not a new Devil Fruit, and black coloration must not falsely claim Armament. Archaeology and body scouting cannot become invented economy/range magic.

context.cutoff: One Piece manga through the end of Wano Country arc
context.coverage: Character-specific capabilities are requirements to verify, not evidence. Record unsupported facts as gaps. No old generated artifacts supplied.

research.subject: Nico Robin
gaps: The requested continuity is supported, but the supplied character page mixes manga, anime, reference-book, SBS, and non-canon material; only facts consistent with the requested manga-through-Wano scope were retained.

The supplied pages do not fully describe the named techniques Clutch, Gigante Fleur, and Demonio Fleur individually enough to verify their exact differences, costs, durations, construction, or all Wano-era variants.
The supplied pages do not provide evidence for exact boss immunity behavior, enemy eligibility restrictions, hold duration, multi-target caps, or interruption rules.
No supplied page establishes numerical game values, upgrade prices, path sequencing, cooldowns, ranges, damage, statuses, projectile flight, target geometry, or resource mechanics.
No supplied page supports turning archaeology, Poneglyph reading, espionage, remote eyes or ears, or body scouting into economy or range magic.
No supplied page supports air-only target classes, tower HP, shields, taunt, invented powers, or Armament Haki coloration for Demonio Fleur.

The supplied material does not establish a complete transformation taxonomy for Robin through Wano; full clones, giant limbs, Gigante Fleur, and Demonio Fleur should not be merged without further source evidence.
The supplied evidence does not specify whether any particular Hana Hana no Mi application requires line of sight, a visible surface, a minimum surface area, or uninterrupted range.
The supplied evidence does not specify whether a target can resist, remove, or break Robin's holds beyond isolated narrative examples.
The supplied evidence does not establish exact limitations on the number of simultaneous replicated parts despite describing the apparent number as unlimited within range.
All game-specific interpretations must be labeled as adaptations rather than canon facts.
